senses.gloss: (= טְעַן דֵּו, v. דֵּיו; cmp. טוּנָא I) adv. with a load of grief, in trouble.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 17:16">Targ. Job XVII, 16</cite> (Regia <he>טַנְדִּי</he>; h. text <cite ref="B00129"><he>בַּדֵּי</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 7a:9">Kidd. 7ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>טב למיתב ט׳ מלמיתב ארמלא</he> Ar. led. <cite ref="I00568"><he>טן דו</he></cite>) it is better to dwell in grief than to dwell in widowhood, i.e. a woman prefers an unhappy married life to singleness.
